image_description: A close-up photograph of a single, large soap bubble floating against a soft-focus green background. The bubble is spherical and transparent, showing strong iridescent reflections in blue, pink, and gold hues on its lower right surface. It reflects a distorted image of the surroundings, including what appears to be a blue sky or object. Several out-of-focus bokeh circles (likely other bubbles or light artifacts) are visible in the upper left background.
